question: Which of the following is a coal deposit basin in Bangladesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Phulbari**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Phulbari coal deposit basin is located in the northwest region of Bangladesh.
 
• It is estimated to hold significant coal reserves, with an estimated deposit of around 572 million tons of coal.
 
• The exploration of the Phulbari coal deposit began in the late 1990s by an international mining company, Asia Energy Corporation (now Global Coal Management Resources or GCM Resources).
 
• The coal in the Phulbari basin is mainly high-quality thermal coal, suitable for open-pit mining. This mining technique involves removing the top layers of soil and rock to access the coal seams.
 
• The proposed open-pit mining project in Phulbari has been met with significant controversies and protests. Local communities, environmental activists, and social organizations have raised concerns about potential environmental and social impacts, including displacement of communities and destruction of agricultural lands.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Phulbari Movement: The Phulbari coal project has been the center of a grassroots movement known as the Phulbari Movement. It gained widespread support and mobilized thousands of people in protests against the project, leading to the suspension of the mining operation.
 
• Environmental Concerns: The Phulbari basin is located in an ecologically sensitive area with fertile agricultural lands, rivers, and biodiversity. Concerns have been raised about the potential pollution of water bodies, loss of agricultural productivity, and negative impacts on the livelihoods of local communities.
 
• Energy Development: Proponents of the Phulbari coal project argue that it would contribute to the energy development of Bangladesh, reduce dependence on imported coal, and provide employment opportunities.
 
• Legal and Regulatory Status: The Phulbari coal project has faced legal and regulatory challenges. The government of Bangladesh has put a halt on the project due to public opposition and concerns about its environmental and social impacts.
 
• Future Uncertainty: The status of the Phulbari coal project remains uncertain, with ongoing debates and discussions about its feasibility, environmental sustainability, and social implications.
